content: I skipped gantry alignment since I had a working core one. My build is complete and it's printing fine. This alignment is not necessary if your Core One is printing fine before the upgrade.

replies.content: Read the comments on the next few steps. Redoing gantry alignment on a working printer can actually cause issues, especially since the gantry aligner tools don't have clearance for the third/lowest screw on each side of the gantry.
